speaker: Unknown
en: It needs to be agent ready for your agent.
zh: 它需要为你的智能体做好准备。

speaker: Unknown
en: If I'm booking, I need to make bookings data ready for bookings agent.
zh: 如果我在做预订,我需要让预订数据为预订智能体做好准备。

speaker: Unknown
en: I need to make it ready for my customer's ChatGPT or my customer's OpenClaw.
zh: 我需要为我的客户的 ChatGPT 或我的客户的 OpenClaw 做好准备。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I need to be ready for my human customer who doesn't have an agent but still wants to browse to booking.com, right?
zh: 而且我还需要为那些没有智能体但仍想浏览 booking.com 的人类客户做好准备,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: So I need to be agent ready.
zh: 所以我需要做到智能体就绪。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what we found out is that agent ready
zh: 而我们发现,智能体就绪

speaker: Unknown
en: It means a lot of things.
zh: 意味着很多事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we heard a lot about AEO, SEO, GEO, how to get discovered.
zh: 所以我们听到了很多关于 AEO、SEO、GEO 的讨论,关于如何被发现。

speaker: Unknown
en: But discovery is only the first step because once an agent knows about you, it still needs to know what you are and how to interact with you and how to authenticate you and how to headlessly pay you, right?
zh: 但发现只是第一步,因为一旦一个智能体知道有你,它仍然需要知道你是什么、如何与你交互、如何对你进行身份验证,以及如何无头地向你付款,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: And actually, when we built, it's an anecdote, but when we built analytics for our product, we asked Claude Code
zh: 实际上,当我们构建——这是个轶事——当我们为我们的产品构建分析功能时,我们问 Claude Code

speaker: Unknown
en: What's the best analytic service?
zh: 最好的分析服务是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: And it recommended PostHog, which is an analytic service.
zh: 它推荐了 PostHog,这是一个分析服务。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we said, no, we prefer Mixpanel because we know Mixpanel.
zh: 我们说,不,我们更喜欢 Mixpanel,因为我们了解 Mixpanel。

speaker: Unknown
en: We worked with Mixpanel for a decade.
zh: 我们和 Mixpanel 合作十年了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We know how to work with it.
zh: 我们知道怎么用它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And Claude Code insisted on PostHog because it said PostHog has better MCP and API and I can integrate to it better.
zh: 而 Claude Code 坚持要 PostHog,因为它说 PostHog 有更好的 MCP 和 API,我可以更好地集成它。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we don't have brand loyalty, right?
zh: 所以我们没有品牌忠诚度,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: We went with PostHog, if that's what Claude Code recommend.
zh: 既然 Claude Code 推荐,我们就用了 PostHog。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it made us think about Mixpanel.
zh: 但这让我们重新思考了 Mixpanel。

speaker: Unknown
en: Mixpanel spent a decade perfecting their UX and developer experience.
zh: Mixpanel 花了十年时间打磨他们的用户体验和开发者体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: We just left it just because Claude Code prefers PostHog.
zh: 我们就这么放弃了它，只因 Claude Code 更喜欢 PostHog。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it will always happen.
zh: 而且这种事总会发生。

speaker: Unknown
en: Hermes, for example, if it uses your product and it needs to spin up a browser to use your product, it will remember that.
zh: 比如说 Hermes，如果它使用了你的产品，并且需要启动一个浏览器来使用你的产品，它会记住这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: And next time, it won't go to your product anymore, right?
zh: 下一次，它就不再去你的产品了，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So at Aura, which is an agentic web research lab,
zh: 所以在 Aura，这是一个智能体网络研究实验室，

speaker: Unknown
en: We started researching.
zh: 我们开始了研究。

speaker: Unknown
en: We raised some capital, and we started researching what does it mean for the web to be ready for agents.
zh: 我们筹集了一些资金，开始研究「网络为智能体做好准备」到底意味着什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we have these readiness benchmarks, which is interesting.
zh: 我们有一些就绪度基准测试，这挺有意思。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can run, it's free, you can go to aura.ai, you can run any website, you get this score and benchmark according to a lot of protocols and best practices, and you have agentic feedback, so the agent actually returns the feedback about your website.
zh: 你可以运行——它是免费的——你可以去 aura.ai，可以运行任何网站，你会得到一个分数和基准评级，依据很多协议和最佳实践，而且你有智能体反馈，所以智能体实际会返回关于你网站的反馈。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we have this leaderboard of how companies and products rank according to this benchmark, and we started mapping the web, and everything was nice, but we hit one insight, or one unexpected result.
zh: 我们有一个排行榜，展示各公司和产品在这个基准下的排名，我们开始绘制整个网络，一切都很顺利，但我们撞上了一个洞察，或者说一个意料之外的结果。

speaker: Unknown
en: We found out, anyone here heard about lms.txt?
zh: 我们发现，在座有谁听说过 lms.txt 吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: LLMs.txt, that's like the de facto standard to be agent-ready.
zh: LLMs.txt，那是一个让网站「智能体就绪」的事实标准。

speaker: Unknown
en: You say, yeah, if your website published in LLMs.txt, agents know how to interact with you.
zh: 就是说，是的，如果你的网站发布了 LLMs.txt，智能体就知道如何与你交互。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you have auth.md and pricing.md and X402 and a lot of standards.
zh: 还有 auth.md、pricing.md、X402 和很多标准。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we found out that almost 50% of the website that we tested, that we ran, published LLMs.txt.
zh: 而我们发现，我们测试过、运行过的网站里，将近 50% 都发布了 LLMs.txt。

speaker: Unknown
en: But none of the agents that we ran on this website actually used llm.txt.
zh: 但我们在这些网站上运行的所有智能体，实际上没有一个用过 llm.txt。

speaker: Unknown
en: Actually, almost all of the agents went straight to the docs page and then the homepage, and the 40% that did use llm.txt used it only because the docs pointed out that there's a file called llm.txt that they need to use.
zh: 实际上，几乎所有智能体都直接去了文档页面，然后是主页，而那 40% 用了 llm.txt 的，也只是因为文档里指出有一个叫 llm.txt 的文件需要它们去用。

speaker: Unknown
en: So then it hit us.
zh: 于是我们恍然大悟。

speaker: Unknown
en: We said,
zh: 我们说，

speaker: Unknown
en: It doesn't make a lot of sense for us as humans to define to agents what they need.
zh: 由我们人类来定义智能体需要什么，这其实说不太通。

speaker: Unknown
en: No one is doing it anymore.
zh: 已经没人这么做了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Even OpenAI, they don't publish best practices for tools anymore because they say that every time they publish best practices, the models become better and these practices become obsolete.
zh: 连 OpenAI 也不再发布针对工具的最佳实践了，因为他们说，每次发布最佳实践，模型就会变得更好，这些实践就过时了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Six months ago, the best practice for an MCP server was, yeah, have three paragraph descriptions so agents will know how to interact with you, and now three lines are enough.
zh: 六个月前，MCP 服务器的最佳实践是，嗯，写三段描述，这样智能体才知道如何与你交互，而现在三行就够了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So best practices becomes we need the agents to define what the agents need, right?
zh: 所以最佳实践变成了：我们需要智能体来定义智能体需要什么，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: We need agents' feedback on this website.
zh: 我们需要智能体对网站给出反馈。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we build Aura's Journey.
zh: 于是我们构建了 Aura's Journey。

speaker: Unknown
en: And Aura's Journey, that's a really cool, that's also free.
zh: Aura's Journey 非常酷，它也是免费的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can go to journey.aura.ai, and you can run on any website, any intent, with any agent, and see the path of the agent as it tries to interact with the website.
zh: 你可以去 journey.aura.ai，可以在任何网站上、以任何意图、用任何智能体运行，并看到智能体尝试与网站交互时的路径。

speaker: Unknown
en: So for example, atia.com, choose Claude Code.
zh: 比如，在 atia.com 上，选择 Claude Code。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we run it on the website.
zh: 然后我们在网站上运行它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you can see in real time how the agent goes and what it tries to look for in the website.
zh: 你可以实时看到智能体的行动，以及它在网站上试图寻找什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we did it tens of thousands of times just to understand what agents really look for when they try to interact with websites.
zh: 我们做了几万次，就是为了弄清楚智能体在尝试与网站交互时真正寻找的是什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the cool thing is not running just one harness.
zh: 而且很酷的一点是，不只是运行一个测试框架。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's running multiple harnesses.
zh: 而是运行多个测试框架。

speaker: Unknown
en: You see here Claude Code and Eve, which is Vercel's harness, and ChatGPT, on the same website with the same intent, okay?
zh: 你在这里看到 Claude Code 和 Eve——那是 Vercel 的测试框架——还有 ChatGPT，在同一个网站上、带着同一个意图，好吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is Claude Code.
zh: 这是 Claude Code。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is Haiku.
zh: 这是 Haiku。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is Eve.
zh: 这是 Eve。

speaker: Unknown
en: See how different the agent journey looks like.
zh: 看看智能体的路径有多不一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is...
zh: 而这是……

speaker: Unknown
en: ChatGPT.
zh: ChatGPT。

speaker: Unknown
en: So ChatGPT could find results better.
zh: 所以 ChatGPT 能更好地找到结果。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can just see the journey across the website.
zh: 你可以看到它在整个网站上的路径。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we need to understand why.
zh: 而我们需要理解为什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: We need to understand why does it happen.
zh: 我们需要理解为什么会发生这种情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why websites publish auth.md files, but agents don't look for auth.md files, and what do they look for?
zh: 为什么网站发布了 auth.md 文件，但智能体不去找 auth.md 文件，它们又在找什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: So in Aura, you can actually go to any business question.
zh: 所以在 Aura，你实际上可以输入任何业务问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: So for any domain, you have business goals or questions, and you can see the paths that the agents are taking.
zh: 对任何域名，你有业务目标或问题，你就能看到智能体所走的路径。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the interesting part of it is that, okay, now we know how agents interact with websites.
zh: 而其中有趣的部分在于，好了，现在我们知道了智能体是如何与网站交互的。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's the next big milestone for the agentic web?
zh: 智能体网络的下一个重大里程碑是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: And for those of you who heard the previous talk, it's discovery.
zh: 对于听过之前演讲的人来说,答案是发现。

speaker: Unknown
en: Right?
zh: 对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: But it's not the discovery that we think of.
zh: 但它不是我们通常理解的那种发现。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not a CO.
zh: 它不是 CO。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not GEO.
zh: 它不是 GEO。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not AEO.
zh: 它不是 AEO。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because we have to remember that every revolution came with its discovery layer.
zh: 因为我们要记住,每一次革命都伴随着它的发现层。

speaker: Unknown
en: Right?
zh: 对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: The web revolution came with search.
zh: 网络革命伴随着搜索而来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Mobile came with app stores.
zh: 移动互联网伴随着应用商店而来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Social came with feeds.
zh: 社交伴随着信息流而来。

speaker: Unknown
en: What is the discovery layer for agentic resources?
zh: 那么,智能体资源的发现层是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: What is the discovery layer for MCPs?
zh: MCP 的发现层是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: What is the discovery layer for OpenAPI.JSON?
zh: OpenAPI.JSON 的发现层是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: What do we even look for?
zh: 我们到底要找什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, maybe Airbnb has a better MCP than Booking.com, but Booking.com has better API than Airbnb, so how do we do it?
zh: 我是说,也许 Airbnb 有比 Booking.com 更好的 MCP,但 Booking.com 有比 Airbnb 更好的 API,那我们该怎么办?

speaker: Unknown
en: Web search, classic web search, it's not enough because it's based on human SEO and human page rank, and it's not flexible enough.
zh: 网络搜索,传统的网络搜索,是不够的,因为它基于人类 SEO 和人类页面排名,而且不够灵活。

speaker: Unknown
en: Custom registries, like per agents or per chats, they're not enough because they're closed and they require every app to submit itself to these registries.
zh: 自定义注册表,比如每个智能体或每个聊天的,也是不够的,因为它们是封闭的,而且要求每个应用把自己提交到这些注册表。

speaker: Unknown
en: And a central registry, like an MCP registry, that's not enough because who will do the curation?
zh: 而一个中心化注册表,比如 MCP 注册表,也是不够的,因为谁来负责策展?

speaker: Unknown
en: What's the governance model?
zh: 治理模型是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: How do we decide which resource comes to that registry?
zh: 我们如何决定哪个资源能进入那个注册表?

speaker: Unknown
en: There are emerging standards around it.
zh: 目前有一些新兴的标准。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's an AI Catalog.json, which is a standard by Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, MCP, and A2A, which standardizes how a website exposes itself to agents.
zh: 有一个 AI Catalog.json,这是由 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、MCP 和 A2A 制定的标准,它规范了一个网站如何向智能体暴露自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: And there's the Agentic Resource Discovery standard.
zh: 还有 Agentic Resource Discovery 标准。

speaker: Unknown
en: Which is by all these companies and more.
zh: 由所有这些公司以及更多公司参与。

speaker: Unknown
en: Which is basically standardized how a discovery layer or a directory exposes itself to agents.
zh: 它基本上规范了一个发现层或一个目录如何向智能体暴露自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we built Oracle Directory, right?
zh: 所以我们构建了 Oracle Directory,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Because we're a research lab for the agentic web.
zh: 因为我们是智能体网络的研究实验室。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we built this.
zh: 所以我们构建了这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: And in Oracle Directory we take all the domains that we scanned or scanned ourselves and we put it in a directory that agents can actually query, right?
zh: 在 Oracle Directory 中,我们把扫描到的或自己扫描的所有域名放进一个目录里,智能体可以实际查询它,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: We expose the AI-catalog.json file.
zh: 我们暴露了 AI-catalog.json 文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can see here, for example, for monday.com, you can see that we generate this JSON file that basically tells agents, yeah, this is the MCP server for monday, this is the API server for monday.com, and you can just, the agents can just query that, right?
zh: 所以你可以在这里看到,比如 monday.com,你可以看到我们生成了这个 JSON 文件,它基本上告诉智能体,是的,这是 monday 的 MCP 服务器,这是 monday.com 的 API 服务器,智能体可以直接查询它,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: So for every domain, you can just go to AI-catalog.json, and we expose the registry, the directory itself.
zh: 所以对于每个域名,你可以直接访问 AI-catalog.json,我们暴露了这个注册表,也就是目录本身。

speaker: Unknown
en: So for every entry on the directory,
zh: 所以对于目录中的每一个条目,

speaker: Unknown
en: We can tell the agent, yeah, for example, Vercel, these are the agentic resource cells, and this is how you access them.
zh: 我们可以告诉智能体,是的,比如 Vercel,这些是智能体资源单元,这就是你访问它们的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: And obviously, this directory is fully ARD or agentic resource discovery compliant, so any agent can just query that directory with any query, right?
zh: 显然,这个目录是完全符合 ARD(智能体资源发现)标准的,所以任何智能体都可以用任何查询来查询这个目录,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is aura.directory, if you want to take a look.
zh: 这是 aura.directory,如果你想去看一看。

speaker: Unknown
en: All of it is part of the aura multiverse, journey, directory, and the ranker.
zh: 这一切都是 aura multiverse 的一部分:journey、directory 和 ranker。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we found out some very other interesting insights.
zh: 而且我们发现了一些非常有趣的其他洞见。

speaker: Unknown
en: For example, being agent ready and being human accessible is very similar.
zh: 比如,对智能体友好和对人类可访问其实非常相似。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because LLMs, when they come to your website, they're like users or people with vision disabilities.
zh: 因为 LLM 来到你的网站时,它们就像有视觉障碍的用户或人。

speaker: Unknown
en: They don't see your website.
zh: 它们看不到你的网站。

speaker: Unknown
en: They need other signals to understand how to work with your website.
zh: 它们需要其他信号来理解如何与你的网站交互。

speaker: Unknown
en: And making your website human-accessible helps agent accessibility and vice versa.
zh: 让你的网站对人类可访问,有助于智能体的可访问性,反之亦然。

speaker: Unknown
en: So to wrap up,
zh: 总结一下,

speaker: Unknown
en: These are MCP apps.
zh: 这些是 MCP 应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is what I've been working on in the past few months.
zh: 这是我过去几个月一直在做的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this was the last piece for the agentic web.
zh: 这是智能体网络的最后一块拼图。

speaker: Unknown
en: This actually brought the agentic web.
zh: 这真正带来了智能体网络。

speaker: Unknown
en: And now agents start to roam the web.
zh: 而现在智能体开始在网上游荡。

speaker: Unknown
en: And agents need different things.
zh: 而智能体需要不同的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: They need different roads.
zh: 它们需要不同的道路。

speaker: Unknown
en: They need different infras.
zh: 它们需要不同的基础设施。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we don't want to rebuild the web for agents.
zh: 但我们不想为智能体重建整个网络。

speaker: Unknown
en: We want to make the web agent accessible.
zh: 我们想让网络对智能体可访问。

speaker: Unknown
en: So let's just make sure the web is prepared for when agents are coming.
zh: 所以我们只要确保网络已经为智能体的到来做好了准备。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you very much.
zh: 非常感谢。
